resources.string: The Music tab, its artwork sources and playback.
The Music tab in the navigation bar. Turning it off hides the tab and stops the player; your library and settings are kept.
Adds HD logos, banners, backgrounds and CD art. A free personal key from fanart.tv (Account, Your API keys). Applies the next time an artist is added or refreshed.

Artist tags and ladder suggestions from Last.fm instead of MusicBrainz, which is often slow or unreachable. A free key from last.fm/api/account/create. MusicBrainz is still used when Last.fm has no answer.
Biographies, logos and backgrounds. Without a key the shared test key is used, which is rate limited. Applies the next time an artist is added or refreshed.
On an artist page, finds where to go next without being asked. Turn off on a slow connection; the page then waits for a button.
Holds the Music pages still: no drifting backgrounds, pulsing, cycling or spinning disc.

MusicBrainz's web service answers one request a second and often turns requests away, which slows artist pages and "Where next?". An offline copy answers instantly. About 3 GB to download, then about ten minutes of building in the background; it keeps about 2 GB.
Building the index, %1$d%%. The app stays usable meanwhile.
